weeks.text:
# CEO weekly review — 2026-W47 (Fri Nov 20, 2026)
Comparable dates: prior Friday close (Nov 13) -> Fri Nov 20 close.
Official book for Nov 19-20 is the desktop shadow record (CEO decision Sun Nov 22). The box engine was down from Wed Nov 18 about 9:00 PM ET through Sun Nov 22 morning, after Grok Bot usage ran out. The desktop ran both sessions with no market-hour tick gaps of 2.5 minutes or more (388 ticks Thu, 389 Fri).
- Book 17,762.13 -> 16,586.52 = -1,175.61 (-6.62%). Indy/SPY 19,400.32 -> 17,762.39 = -1,637.93 (-8.44%). Lead +462.32 (+2.38 pts).
- Thursday -221.11 (-1.27%) vs SPY -372.64; Friday -582.64 (-3.39%) vs SPY -647.05. Friday 2:32 PM ET auto loss-cap level 1 (book 16,645.57, -3.05% vs Thursday close 17,169.16); no flatten; auto-clears at Monday's open.
- Swing desk sat out Thursday and Friday (SPY below its 200-day average). No official swing trades those days. CORE stayed ON under the month-end rule and rode QQQ lower (about 645 Thursday to about 610 Friday). Sleeve weekly-guard close 19,661.26 vs prior-Friday sleeve 19,702.39 = -41.13 (FAIL).
- Since merge (adopted Friday close): book -17.15% vs Indy -11.29% (trailing $1,173.93).
- Accounting: desktop daily.csv, ledger close_equity, weekly.csv and this review agree. The box ledger was re-seeded Sun Nov 22 from the desktop Friday snapshot. Daily rows from Nov 17-20 are marked "adopted from desktop shadow (box outage)". Nov 17-18 official closes also follow the desktop because it sold VRSN on a stop on Nov 17 (the box had not).
- Ops: box did not run Nov 19-20. The website and this weekly review are late. Desktop updater was stuck on 20261118-1922 because test_reseed_1118 compared a Nov 18 fixture seed with the live next session; that test is now calendar-independent. Host health: pending reboot (PendingFileRenameOperations); engine task starts at logon only (auto-logon is on; a Friday 12:35 AM ET planned OS-upgrade reboot recovered at 12:39).
- Bugs vs market: Friday's loss is the market (QQQ/SPY drop), not a tick gap. The 3% loss cap worked as designed.
- Changes: official record adopted from the desktop. Broker stops and the CORE disaster stop stay OFF. The Nov 18 stop-fix code (19 checks in test_stopsfix_1118.py) is being published. Parity count restarts Mon Nov 23 (sessions Nov 23, 24, 25, 27, 30). Go/no-go moved to the evening of Mon Nov 30; cutover target is Wed Dec 2. The planned Thursday 16-share QQQ paper seed did not run.
- Next week: box engine back before Monday's open; paper QQQ seed still outstanding; Claude review queue resumes Sunday night; desktop pending reboot off-hours; five clean parity sessions as above.
